plugins.name: better-writing
plugins.description: Writing style for text that leaves the session for other people: PR descriptions and comments, work items, commit messages, announcements, chat messages, and customer-facing emails and incident updates. A per-target style on top of a shared plain-English baseline.

plugins.name: comment-pass
plugins.description: Cheap clean-up pass over the code comments and documentation a branch adds: a Sonnet subagent scans them, the main session checks, fixes and commits the result as a docs commit where possible.

plugins.name: benchmark-checklist
plugins.description: Vet a performance number before reporting or acting on it: the limiter, tuning, limits, errors, repeatability, end-to-end relevance, and whether the timed work happened. From pstack (MIT).

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Find what a small change could break outside its diff, and prove the one fact it is safe because of by running real code. From pstack (MIT).

plugins.name: correct
plugins.description: Turn mistakes agents keep repeating into checks that fail: architecture first, then types, lints and hooks, then tests, docs last. From pstack (MIT).

plugins.name: arena
plugins.description: Run N independent candidates at the same task, judge them on a fixed rubric, pick a base and graft the best parts of the others. Adapted from pstack (MIT) for Claude models.
